title: How Does Prepopulating Search Bars with Keywords Affect Online Consumer Behavior? A Field Experiment
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment (72,587 consumers) with three prefilled search-bar keyword arms vs empty bar. Tables 3-6 are cross-sectional OLS of consumer-level outcomes on arm dummies T1-T3 with gender and age-tier controls. No DiD; shipped data simulated.
design_notes: Table3Main.do etc.: reg <outcome> T1 T2 T3 Female AgeTier; Tables 4-5 one arm vs control.
data_files_note: README: 'Simulated data that can be used to replicate each column'.
data_provenance_note: README describes every .dta as simulated data.
software_notes: One do-file per column plus *Main.do per table.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
